newsitem.title: USA: Medarex names Irwin Lerner chairman.
newsitem.headline: Medarex names Irwin Lerner chairman.

text.p: Medarex Inc said Monday Irwin Lerner has become chairman of the board of directors succeeding Charles Schaller, who continues to serve as a director.

Lerner, the recently retired chairman of the board and chairman of the executive committee of Roche Holding Ltd's Hoffmann-LaRoche Inc, has been a member of the Medarex board since 1995. During his over 31 years at Hoffmann-LaRoche, Lerner also served as president and chief executive officer from 1980-1992.
Lerner is currently Distinguished Executive-in-Residence at the Rutgers University Graduate School of Management.
